name: loom-enhanced-research
historical_slice_note: Historical baseline asset for the first born-governanced slice. This file records the born-governanced baseline and does not by itself redefine the latest governed completion contract when later enhancement slices add stronger governed evidence requirements.

inputs.research_goal: Required research objective for the governed run.
inputs.seed_query: Optional seed query for the first research round.
inputs.seed_urls: Optional seed URLs for the first research round.
inputs.max_depth: Required bounded depth for research passes.
inputs.output_root: Required artifact root for run outputs.
inputs.demo_mode: Required demo-mode toggle or scenario hint.
inputs.user_language: Required user language for guided output and freeform inputs.
inputs.material_review_decision: Required structured decision after material review: more_research or draft.
inputs.material_review_comments: Required native-language freeform comments during material review.
inputs.draft_review_decision: Required structured decision after draft review: finalize, more_research, or reselect_materials.
inputs.draft_review_comments: Required native-language freeform comments during draft review.

default_assumptions.ledger_artifacts: Create and maintain data/, notes/, materials/, ui/, qa-pairs.txt, error-handling.txt, and report artifacts before the first substantive research action.
default_assumptions.round_contract: Each research round records trigger, working hypothesis, chosen action, evidence gathered, and next-step decision.
default_assumptions.action_classes: The workflow starts with abstract action classes such as search, dig, compare, fact-check, and summarize rather than hard-binding to one toolchain.
default_assumptions.material_review_rule: After bounded research, assemble a full material inventory and present it to the user before report drafting.
default_assumptions.freeform_input_rule: Every ask-user checkpoint and every UI form must include native-language freeform input, and that input is first-class workflow input.
default_assumptions.evidence_creation_boundary: Only the research loop may create new evidence; material-review and draft-review loops work on existing evidence plus user comments.
default_assumptions.draft_review_boundary: Draft review evaluates the written report draft, not the raw material inventory.

outputs.published_package_workflow_evidence: Evidence that the published package workflow path was attempted before any downstream work.
outputs.resolved_runtime_version_ref: Exact runtime version evidence for the bound SO bundle.
outputs.runtime_bundle_packages_ref: Exact runtime bundle package evidence for the bound SO bundle.
outputs.published_runtime_preflight_failure: Human-reviewable evidence for the published bundle preflight failure.
outputs.workaround_approval_ref: Recorded user approval for the blocked-state workaround.
outputs.workaround_runtime_ref: Path or reference to the approved workaround runtime directory.
outputs.workaround_runtime_guide_ref: Fresh guide path exported from the approved workaround runtime.
outputs.resolved_guide_surface_ref: Fresh guide evidence used as the gate before downstream work.
outputs.evidence_delta: Net-new evidence published only by the research loop.
outputs.material_candidates: Accumulated candidate materials from research rounds.
outputs.material_inventory: Structured reviewable inventory of gathered materials.
outputs.continuation_payload: Structured payload that merges user selections and freeform native-language comments for the next workflow step.
outputs.report_draft: Generated report draft from existing evidence.
outputs.completion_manifest_reference: Runtime-owned completion-manifest path that references the governed source deliverables and final outputs and anchors the final governed completion verdict surface for this target skill.
outputs.completion_manifest_md: Runtime-owned human-reviewable completion manifest. It is the fixed completion verdict and evidence checklist surface for the target skill's final governed handoff.
